UC.note: rocksalt Fm-3m; verified mp-id (CompoundsToPredict.csv). n_symmetry_ops corrected to 48 (live MP 2026-06-25; notebook 3 showed 96 which was an artifact).

CeO2.note: fluorite Fm-3m; verified mp-id (CeO2Nd2O3Vals.csv). Symmetry confirmed from live MP 2026-06-25.

UO2.note: fluorite Fm-3m; lowest e_above_hull UO2 in MP. Confirmed from live MP 2026-06-25. mp-308 (hexagonal, sg=189) is an experimental polymorph but higher energy — do not use as default.

PuO2.note: fluorite Fm-3m; lowest e_above_hull PuO2 in MP. Confirmed from live MP 2026-06-25.

ThO2.note: fluorite Fm-3m; lowest e_above_hull ThO2 in MP. Confirmed from live MP 2026-06-25. mp-1102569 (Pnma, experimental) has higher e_hull=0.1497.

ZrO2.note: baddeleyite P2_1/c; lowest e_above_hull ZrO2 in MP. Confirmed from live MP 2026-06-25. For UO2-ZrO2 solid solutions, the host is UO2 (fluorite); ZrO2 reference only needed if Zr-dominant.

Nd2O3.note: bixbyite Ia-3; lowest e_above_hull Nd2O3 in MP. Confirmed from live MP 2026-06-25. mp-2763 (trigonal P-3m1) is slightly higher energy.

NdO2.note: NON-HOST: Nd4+ is not a stable oxidation state; NdO2 is not a viable fluorite host. For Ce1-xNdxO2 solid solutions, use CeO2 (mp-20194) as reference. Confirmed from live MP 2026-06-25.
